description: gilyon/snes-tests cputest (S-CPU 65816 opcode test, 'full' variant, 1610 tests) at tag v1.4, patched to report over the VELOCE-RESULT/1 $21FE port (SNES-3). make_cpu_tests.py also writes tests-full-veloce.inc, a per-test expected-value table (X/Y/P+E/A, optional S/DBR/D, memory checks, test name) in the unused LoROM banks 5-7. main.asm emits one CHECK line per test: PASS, or FAIL naming the first mismatching field with exp/got (and at= for memory) plus a REG a/x/y/p/e/s/d/dbr line. `fail:` records the failure and continues with the next test instead of waiting for a key press; END <pass>/<total> closes the transcript.

golden_gate_reason: cputest-full.sfc is not shipped in the repo: the generated tests-full.inc/tests-full.txt/tests-full.map (from make_cpu_tests.py) and the .sfc itself are all gitignored (cputest/.gitignore: 'tests*.inc tests*.txt tests*.map'), a build-only ROM with nothing to byte-compare against. The unpatched build is still run first (build.py does that before applying patches), and the patched ROM was verified behaviourally -- see PROVENANCE.md.
